messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Norðurþing er frábært samfélag fyrir fjölskyldufólk. Fyrir utan fegurð svæðisins og alla afþreyinguna sem í boði er er Norðurþing veðursælt og fólkið kærleiksríkt. Í Norðurþingi líður mér alltaf vel og er mitt heima.

message.content: Norðurþing is a great community for families. In addition to the beauty of the area and all the recreation on offer, Norðurþing is weather-beaten and the people are loving. In Norðurþing I always feel well and it is my home.
